title: Kh'ymm
description: As an inquisitive and excitable astronomer on the Observatory Moon, Kh'ymm was a natural choice for Jod Na Nawood to turn to for help in finding At Attin. Unfortunately, she knew him as Crimson Jack and didn't trust him at all. While she was thrilled by the astrogation problem he posed, she feared that he was a danger to the children and stalled them until New Republic authorities could arrive.
